outgoing.name: Japan
outgoing.excerpt: It became popular in Japan in 1986, when it was published by Nikoli and given the name Sudoku.

outgoing.name: Leonhard Euler
outgoing.excerpt: Leonhard Euler is sometimes (incorrectly) cited as the source of the puzzle, based on his work with Latin squares.

outgoing.name: Logic
outgoing.excerpt: Sudoku (数独, sūdoku ?), also known as Number Place or Nanpure, is a logic-based placement puzzle.
